title: Button
description: The action control, 1.0 variants: subtle (default) for ordinary actions, surface for toolbar actions, inverse for the main action of a card or a list title row, outline beside an inverse one, ghost for icon buttons, primary / secondary (the brand fills) only for the one main button of a page, a dialog or the nav, danger for destructive actions. Spinner shows work in progress inside the control that runs it.
when: Any action: save, create, refresh, delete, open a dialog.
Icon-only toolbar actions (iconOnly + aria-label); an attention count on one with badge.
Dialog footers (size="modal": 44px touch target on phones): commit primary, cancel subtle, a destructive confirm danger.
Round icon buttons over media, in an overlay header or beside a carousel (iconOnly + shape="round"); the inverse pill of a list title row (size="xs" shape="round").

instead.use: next/link (styled with BTN_* from @semi/ui/styles when it must look like a button)

a11y: Renders a real <button type="button"> (pass type="submit" in forms).
iconOnly requires aria-label (the types enforce it); keep a title for the tooltip. With badge, say the count in the aria-label ("Thông báo, 3 chưa đọc").
loading sets aria-busy and blocks clicks. Keyboard focus is a 2px outline in the strong text colour on every variant; disabled is neutral for every variant.
A 24px hit area at every size that grows to 44px on a touch screen (any-pointer-coarse), without a bigger drawn button.

examples.title: Variants
examples.description: subtle (default) for ordinary actions, surface for toolbar actions, inverse for a card's or a list title row's main action, outline beside it, ghost for quiet and icon actions, primary / secondary (brand) for the one main button of the page or dialog, danger for destructive. The second row is disabled: neutral for every variant.

examples.title: Icon and icon-only
examples.description: icon adds a leading icon; iconOnly needs an aria-label.

examples.title: Round
examples.description: shape="round" makes an icon-only button a circle (media tiles, overlay headers, carousel arrows) and a labelled one a pill; the fill, focus and size stay the variant's.

examples.title: Loading
examples.description: loading swaps the icon for a spinner and blocks clicks.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: xs (24px) for the inverse pill of a list title row, sm (28px, 12px text) for dense rows and toolbars, md (default, 14px text) for content, modal for dialog footers and a full-width commit; badge pins an attention count to an icon button.
